# Lumina · Light
> The Photoshop post-processing suite for DSH: drive **your local Adobe Photoshop** from a script to
grade game screenshots / photos — persistent session, parameterized recipes, one-call automated out
put, objective QA, style LUTs, HDR highlight reconstruction, optional super-resolution, and pixel-le
vel visual inspection.
Lumina is a DSH host plugin (bundle). It turns "drive PS from the command line" — a loop where every
iteration costs a permission prompt, a 6-second cold start, hand-written JSX, and silent-failure tr
ial and error — into an everyday delivery tool that runs **≈5 seconds per iteration with automatic m
etrics and reproducible parameters**:
- **Persistent Photoshop session**: one cold start, then ~5 seconds per image; automatically restart

s and retries after a crash or kill.
- **Parameterized recipes**: 19 grading recipes + 5 built-in st
yle LUTs; every parameter can be deep-merged and overridden, and versions can be appended iterativel
y. **Styles themselves are hot-reloadable data packs** (add/replace them without restarting, includi

ng parameter-only presets).
- **Any framing**: game screenshots, real photos, portrait/square/ultra-

wide images all work; only a screenshot UI strip detected with high confidence is cropped away.
- **
Auto mode**: just drop in an image — it crops the UI strip, decides character vs. landscape, runs HD

R highlight reconstruction when needed, and applies an accepted draft preset.
- **Optional super-res
olution preprocessing**: small/low-detail sources can first run through an external AI upscaler (Rea
l-ESRGAN / waifu2x, ...), with a built-in Lanczos fallback when no external tool is configured, befo

re HDR reconstruction and grading.

## Installation
### Requirements
**Photoshop compatibility**: 2025 (26.x) tested; 2020-2024 expected (older `Select Subject` failures
degrade gracefully); 2019 and earlier unsupported; Photoshop Elements / macOS unsupported (Windows
fully); 2019 and earlier unsupported; Photoshop Elements / macOS unsupported (Windows COM required).
- Windows 10/11 + **Adobe Photoshop** (developed and verified against Photoshop 2025; `ps_grade` rel

ies on Windows COM, earlier versions are untested).
- The DSH desktop app (the host plugin runs in t

he DSH host process, which is what makes launching Photoshop COM possible).
- Node.js ≥ 20 (the DSH

bundled runtime is enough).
- Python 3.10+, with `numpy` and `Pillow` (already included in the DSH b
undled runtime; install them yourself for standalone use).
> Photoshop's **install path needs no configuration**: automation launches it through the system's P

hotoshop COM registration;
> only style LUTs need the `Presets/3DLUTs` folder, which is auto-detecte
d (see below); unusual installs can set `lutDir`.
### Install from npm (recommended)

## Architecture
[代码示例省略，未执行]
- **Must run in the host process**: the DSH shell sits in a low-integrity sandbox and cannot activat

e Photoshop's COM; running the plugin in the host process is the prerequisite for driving PS.
- **No
DSH restart needed for tuning**: `assets/recipes.json`, `assets/pipeline.jsx`, and `assets/*.py` ar
e read from disk on every call; style packs and the case bank are hot-reloaded by mtime; only change

s to `index.js` / `lib/*.js` require a restart.
- **Many ExtendScript adjustment interfaces in PS 20
25 silently no-op** (`adjustCurves`, Hue/Saturation, Invert, ...); `pipeline.jsx` only uses APIs tha

t were verified one by one on greyscale test images and actually change pixels.
- CJK paths in UTF-8
and Python→Node stdout UTF-8 are handled; after a PS crash/force-kill, the next call restarts it au
tomatically and retries once.
## Known limitations
- Once 8-bit screenshot highlights clip (e.g. a fully white sky), the original detail is irreversibl
e; `hdrsynth.py` **infers/paints** rather than restores, and does not guarantee semantic correctness

.
- `ps_grade` supports Windows + Adobe Photoshop only; `ps_measure` / the vision tools and metric c

omputation are cross-platform.
- Style LUTs need the local Photoshop-bundled `Presets/3DLUTs`; a tri

mmed Photoshop install without LUT files will skip styles.
- LUTs are not written into the PSD (the

PSD is the pre-LUT version); the final PNG is the version with the LUT.
- **Super-resolution is only
preprocessing**: the built-in Lanczos does not add real detail; the quality/licence of external AI
super-resolution depends on the tool you hook up — the plugin bundles no models and makes no semanti
c guarantee about super-resolution results. A missing/failing engine or a corrupt frame falls back a

utomatically and never blocks output.
- **Very large but soft images are not auto-upscaled** (only a
"consider AI restore" hint), avoiding a pointless 12MP→48MP blow-up; only small/low-resolution imag

es are auto-upscaled.
- Phone-photo **EXIF orientation is auto-normalised** (portrait shots are no l
onger processed sideways), provided the file still carries the orientation tag; images with complete

ly stripped metadata can only be processed as raw pixels.
- Auto classification is heuristic: if a c
omplex image is misclassified as a screenshot (or vice versa), override it explicitly with `crop` /

`auto.scene` / `recipe`.
- The `depth` mask only layers by frame height; near/far objects at the sam

e height cannot be distinguished; use `polygon` / `alpha` for intricate scenes.
- AI "Select Subject
" may pull neighbouring objects into the subject in complex scenes (the result reports the AI select

ion area as a hint); narrow it with a hand-drawn polygon.
- Auto mode is a first draft; when it is n

ot satisfying, append versions with `params` + `project` and keep iterating.
- Cold-starting Photosh
op takes ~6–10 seconds; warm, each image is ~5 seconds (4K images take longer; super-resolution adds
extra Python processing time and disk usage).
